description: Stereo panner in which the two inputs travel in opposite directions across the outputs; also a crossfader or a VCA

params.text: Crossfades the two inputs across the two outputs in opposite directions, 0 to 5, with both inputs equally present at 2.5
Attenuverts the pan jack, -1 to +1, fully positive by default
Picks linear crossfading or an equal-power curve between the two outputs

inputs.text: One of the two signals being crossfaded; it arrives at Out L with Pan at maximum and at Out R with Pan at minimum
One of the two signals being crossfaded; it arrives at Out R with Pan at maximum and at Out L with Pan at minimum
Modulates the pan position through its attenuverter

outputs.text: A crossfade carrying In R with Pan at minimum and In L with Pan at maximum
A crossfade carrying In L with Pan at minimum and In R with Pan at maximum

notes: bypassing the module passes In L to Out L and In R to Out R unchanged
